svg.title: Crosstalk: the Marvel Wikipedia switchboard
svg.desc: 303 pages and 1784 directed links, drawn without arrows. The largest weak component contains 277 pages. Small components are positioned in a separate observation lane. Circle size shows in-degree.

circle.title: Will o' the Wisp: 1 incoming / 2 outgoing
Bob, Agent of Hydra: 2 incoming / 7 outgoing
Rom the Space Knight: 8 incoming / 8 outgoing

g.text: One weak component. Many possible routes.
